name: Enda Yoneharu
source:
Name: Yoneharu Enda
Sex: Male
Age: 46
Birthday: April 12
Profession: Comedian
Likes: Ferris Wheels, Things That Spin, Bow Ties, Family
Dislikes: Oden, Super Hot Baths, Electric Shocks, Spicy Foods, Pie
Hobbies: Game Commentary, Short Clip Submissions, Survival Games
Skills: Quizzes, One-Liners (Self-Proclaimed)

[Past]
A former "Quiz King" turned comedian. His stage name is Andes Komeji. He has made some TV appearances but isn’t very successful. His money troubles led to a divorce from his wife, and he now lives with his son Shoma.

[From the in-game character descriptions]

[spoiler]Komeji is the last victim killed in the HB Case in the Past, 6 Years Ago.[/spoiler]
